sources.snippet: 🗣️ KinyaWhisper KinyaWhisper is a fine-tuned version of OpenAI's Whisper model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in Kinyarwanda. sources.snippet: KinyaWhisper is an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model specifically optimized for Kinyarwanda, fine-tuned based on OpenAI's Whisper architecture. This project is dedicated to providing high-quality speech recognition solutions for low-resource languages, particularly offering advanced AI speech technology support for the Kinyarwanda-speaking community.
